views.label: Session
views.note: Version discovery, then a login whose sessionID rides the Auth header; a login or bulk failure is exit 1.

views.label: Three bulk sweeps
views.note: Profiles, templates and expand=all hardware cover the whole appliance; then the session is closed.

views.label: BMC reachability
views.note: One unauthenticated GET per iLO; no BMC credentials are ever held.

views.label: Ingest
views.note: A changed server is written with a revision CAS, an identical one only touch_seen'd (ADR-0044).

messages.label: GET /rest/server-hardware?expand=all, 25 a page (DIMMs, drives, PCI inline)
members joined to profiles in memory
GET {hardware}/powerSupplies — only where expand=all lacked them
GET {hardware}/processors — only where expand=all lacked them; the source of cpu_threads
DELETE /rest/login-sessions, before any iLO probe or ingest (failure logged)
GET https://<iLO>/redfish/v1, unauthenticated (BmcProbedProvider)
messages.note: one shared httpx client, batches of 64, 5 s; interleaved with ingest

messages.label: HTTP or TLS error = reachable; refused/timeout = unreachable, not PARTIAL
classify + health + audit; changed: revision CAS, else touch_seen

cards.title: One source for every HPE server
items: OneView is the only HPE source whatever the iLO generation (4, 5 or 6): no BMC login, no per-generation branch; iLO is only probed for reachability (ADR-0022, ADR-0037)
What that costs on Gen10/Gen11 is written down, not worked around: cpu_threads only via /processors, GPU VRAM from the catalog
One appliance: for 821 servers about 33 hardware pages (25 each) and 3 profile pages (256 each), plus templates; the 2500-server ceiling is documented, not coded

cards.title: Settled on a live appliance, 2026-09-07
items: 821 servers, 685 profiles: nextPageUri paging fetched all 685, so the 256 cap is per request, no sharding
Omitting X-Api-Version silently serves an older schema (server-hardware-1 vs -12, both 200) — the header is always sent
iLO 5/6 populate memoryMb/processorCount near-universally (797/797, 24/24); 140 members with no profile are skipped by design

cards.title: Still open
items: GPU mapping is unverified: no GPU-bearing HPE host exists in the estate, so no Devices entry has ever reported DeviceType GPU
Whether AMS was running was not established; the profile name stays the only field trusted for ProviderServer.name
count=-1 means 64 on /rest/server-profiles — an explicit count is always sent and truncation is reported as a PARTIAL run

cards.title: Exit codes
items: Login or bulk-call failure is OneViewConnectionError, exit 1; a truncated list is a recorded error, exit 3; schedule 0 */3 * * *
An unreachable iLO is a reachable=False stub and does not make the run PARTIAL (ADR-0037)
A mapping failure is a COLLECTION_ERROR stub, exit 3, or 1 when 5+ servers and over 20% failed (ADR-0062)
